QA Automation Engineer

Own test automation for a healthcare platform.

Responsibilities:
- Build Selenium automation suites for regression testing
- Develop Cypress tests for front-end journeys
- Maintain SQL data setup for test cases
- Design the automation framework

Requirements:
- 3+ years of strong Selenium experience, must have
- Cypress required
- SQL exposure is nice to have
- 3 to 6 years of total experience
